{{Quote|A candle will I light, for you to find your way home.|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], to a young [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]|<ref name="Y:DR" />}}
A '''candle''' was an archaic illumination source. Candles were made of meltable material, with a central wick which was lit to give light as it [[Fire/Legends|burned]].<ref name="BFE" /> The light produced by a candle was dim and flickering.<ref name="HE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> To prevent extinguishment or excessive flickering, they were sometimes put into portable cases.<ref name="BFE" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a [[Rrhr hunting band|band]] of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] kidnapped [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker Lars]], [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and kept her [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] among their encampment. Skywalker eventually found his dying mother held within a hut illuminated by dozens of candles.<ref name="AOC">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>

Beyond their practical use, candles were also lit around [[Burial/Legends|graves]] and tombs in honor of the dead.<ref name="HE" /> When a deceased [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] could not be cremated in the vicinity of the [[Livet Tower/Legends|Livet Tower]], which contained an [[Eternal Flame]], it was customary to place a lighted candle on their chest.<ref name="SWDP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> On the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] holiday of [[the Devouring]], some people used to burning candles to ward away evil spirits.<ref name="Xim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>

On festive occasions, candles were used to ornate various kinds of pastries.<ref name="Wiz">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030501kessel|text=Kessel: Hell in Space|int=Kessel: Hell in Space}}</ref> They were also used to create a cosy atmosphere suitable for romantic dates.<ref name="CoTJ" /> Intimate<ref name="COPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> and formal dinners often used candles or candelabra to light the table.<ref name="TOPPS">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: A New Hope|cardname=Dinner with Lord Tion}}</ref>

Like many ther mundane objects, candles could be turned into [[Magic/Legends|enchanted]] artifacts. The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]], [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] of the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], owned the [[Candle of Pure Light]], a magical candle that never burned down and could summon [[Izrina]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of the [[Wistie/Legends|Wisties]].<ref name="CCEA">''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref>
